headline: The Indian IT services sector showed mixed performance in Q2 FY27, with strong AI-driven growth for some firms but modest top‑line expansion and guidance cuts for others.
summary: Revenue growth varied widely, from double‑digit gains at Coforge, LTM and Tech Mahindra to low single‑digit growth at Infosys. Profitability improved at most peers, though Infosys and Wipro saw modest or declining profit margins. Several companies highlighted AI as a key growth driver, while guidance outlooks were trimmed for Infosys and newly introduced for HCLTech and Wipro.

themes.title: AI‑driven services gaining traction
themes.detail: Multiple firms reported double‑digit AI revenue growth or AI‑led contract wins, underpinning higher profit margins.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% outlook, reflecting cautious market expectations.
